title: 「年寄りはスマホも使えない」と笑った嫁が、姑のノートを見て泣いた理由
style: Photorealistic cinematic Japanese TV drama, shot on a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft natural daylight, realistic skin texture, vertical 9:16 framing. All dialogue is spoken in natural Japanese.
location: A modern two-generation family house in a quiet Tokyo suburb where kazuko lives with her son's family: a bright living room with a wooden floor, a low table and a sofa, a hallway, and a small tatami room behind a sliding paper door.

kazuko.name: 和子（姑・68歳）
kazuko.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 68-year-old Japanese woman, kind but dignified face, short neat gray-black bob, light makeup, beige knit cardigan over a cream blouse, thin gold reading glasses hanging on a fine chain around her neck. Upper body, facing camera, soft restaurant background, natural window light, 9:16 vertical.

rena.name: 麗奈（嫁・38歳）
rena.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 38-year-old Japanese woman, fashionable and slightly haughty expression, long wavy brown hair, polished makeup, white silk blouse, designer handbag strap on shoulder. Upper body, facing camera, soft restaurant background, natural window light, 9:16 vertical.

shots.prompt: Hook shot. In the hallway, rena, in casual home clothes, is talking on her smartphone to a friend, laughing mockingly, and says in Japanese: 「うちのお義母さん、スタンプ一つ送れないの。年寄りにスマホなんて無理なのよ」. In the foreground, kazuko stands behind a half-open sliding paper door, holding a simple flip-case smartphone; she hears everything and quietly lowers the phone with a hurt face. Kazuko does not speak.
shots.captions: うちのお義母さん／スタンプ一つ／送れないの（笑）／年寄りにスマホなんて／無理なのよ

shots.prompt: Kazuko sits alone on her knees in the small tatami room, soft window light. She smooths out a community-center flyer on the low table (the flyer's writing is blurred and unreadable), then lifts her eyes with quiet resolve and whispers in Japanese: 「…年寄りだって、やればできるわよ」.
shots.captions: …年寄りだって／やればできるわよ

shots.prompt: A Japanese community center room with folding tables, several elderly people holding smartphones, bright fluorescent light. A young female instructor stands at a whiteboard (no readable writing). First a calm female Japanese narrator voice-over says: 「毎週火曜、こっそり通い始めたスマホ教室」. Then the instructor says in Japanese: 「宅配業者を装った詐欺メッセージが増えています。押してしまったら、すぐカード会社に連絡を」. Kazuko, at a front table, listens seriously. Kazuko does not speak.
shots.captions: 毎週火曜——／こっそり通い始めた／スマホ教室／宅配業者を装った／詐欺メッセージに注意／押してしまったら／すぐカード会社へ

shots.prompt: Close-up at the community center table. Kazuko, wearing her thin gold reading glasses, carefully writes in a small notebook by hand, pages full of handwritten steps and tiny drawings of app icons (all handwriting blurred and unreadable). Her smartphone lies beside the notebook. Nobody speaks; quiet room ambience.
shots.captions: だまされたら——／①カード会社に電話／②188に相談

shots.prompt: A few weeks later, the living room. Rena lounges on the sofa looking at a text message on her smartphone (the screen faces away and is not visible) and mutters to herself in Japanese: 「お荷物のお届けにあがりましたが、不在のため…？荷物なんて頼んでたっけ。まあいいや」. Then, bored and careless, she takes her credit card from her wallet and quickly types the number into the phone with her thumb and taps.
shots.captions: お荷物のお届けに／あがりましたが…？／荷物なんて／頼んでたっけ／まあいいや

shots.prompt: Close-up of rena on the sofa. Her smartphone buzzes with a notification (screen not visible). She looks at it, her face goes pale, her hand starts to shake, and she says in a panicked voice in Japanese: 「え…？9万8千円！？私、何も買ってない…！」.
shots.captions: えっ…？／98,000円！？／私、何も／買ってない…！

shots.prompt: Kazuko walks into the living room and sees rena trembling on the sofa. Kazuko asks gently in Japanese: 「麗奈さん、どうしたの？」. Rena, close to tears, answers in Japanese: 「お義母さん、どうしよう…さっきのメッセージ、押しちゃって…」.
shots.captions: 麗奈さん／どうしたの？／お義母さん／どうしよう…／さっきのメッセージ／押しちゃって…

shots.prompt: Role reversal. Kazuko sits beside rena, calmly opens her small handwritten notebook (writing unreadable), points at the back of rena's credit card and says steadily in Japanese: 「落ち着いて。まずカード会社に電話して、カードを止めてもらうの。カードの裏の番号よ」. Rena nods, trembling. Rena does not speak.
shots.captions: 落ち着いて／まずカード会社に電話して／カードを止めてもらうの／カードの裏の番号よ

shots.prompt: Rena holds the phone to her ear. A muffled female call-center voice from the phone says in Japanese: 「不正利用の疑いがあるため、カードを停止いたします」. Rena slumps down onto the floor in relief. Kazuko kneels beside her, gently rubs her back and says softly in Japanese: 「よかった。あとで、いちはちはちにも相談しておこうね」.
shots.captions: カードを／停止いたします／よかった…／あとで188にも／相談しておこうね

shots.prompt: Rena picks up kazuko's small notebook from the low table and opens the first page: shaky elderly handwriting (blurred and unreadable). Close-up of her fingers touching the words; a tear drops onto the paper. A calm female Japanese narrator voice-over says: 「ノートの最初のページには、こう書かれていた」. Rena does not speak.
shots.captions: ノートの最初のページ——／「麗奈さんに何度も／聞かなくていいように」

shots.prompt: Kazuko smiles a little shyly and says in Japanese: 「何度も聞いて、麗奈さんの手を煩わせたくなかったのよ」. Rena, in tears, bows her head and says in Japanese: 「お義母さん…ひどいこと言って、本当にごめんなさい」.
shots.captions: 麗奈さんの手を／煩わせたくなかったのよ／お義母さん…／ひどいこと言って／本当にごめんなさい

shots.prompt: Soft afternoon light. Kazuko gently takes rena's hands in hers, smiles warmly and says in Japanese: 「いいのよ。年寄りだって、まだまだ覚えられるんだから」. The camera slowly pulls back.
shots.captions: いいのよ／年寄りだって／まだまだ／覚えられるんだから

shots.prompt: That night, warm evening lamp light in the living room. Rena's smartphone vibrates (screen not visible). She looks at it, her teary face breaks into a smile, she laughs softly through tears and taps a reply. Nobody speaks; quiet room ambience.
shots.captions: その夜——／お義母さんから／初めてのスタンプ

ending.question:
あなたの親は、
スマホ使えますか？
ending.note: ※本内容は、実際のエピソードを基に再構成したものです。
